verses.english: “Mendicants, these four things are very helpful to a human being.
Associating with true persons, listening to the true teaching, rational application of mind, and practicing in line with the teaching.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā manussabhūtassa bahukārā hontī”ti.
verses.english: These four things are very helpful to a human being.”
